# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service
[Unit]
Description=Back up inventory data to node1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/srv/inventory/data

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup

# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer
[Unit]
Description=Nightly inventory backup to node1

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:15:00
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=5m
Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

script_key_settings:
SOURCE_DIR=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_HOST=10.100.228.10
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
ARCHIVE=inventory-$TODAY.tar.gz
tar -C "$SOURCE_DIR" -czf "$LOCAL_TMP" .
scp -q -i "$IDENTITY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" "$LOCAL_TMP" "$DEST_USER@$DEST_HOST:$DEST_DIR/$REMOTE_TMP"
ssh -i "$IDENTITY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" "$DEST_USER@$DEST_HOST" "mv -- '$DEST_DIR/$REMOTE_TMP' '$DEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE' && find '$DEST_DIR' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
ssh -i "$IDENTITY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" "$DEST_USER@$DEST_HOST" "mv -- '$DEST_DIR/$REMOTE_TMP' '$DEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE' && find '$DEST_DIR' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
